facts.fact: Reston 与 Jody 相差七岁、长相几乎一模一样（五点钟阴影 vs Jody 的小胡子）。
facts.anchor: Even though they’re seven years apart in age, there’s absolutely no mistaking Jody and Reston Fisher for brothers.

facts.fact: Reston 请她代收 Jody 生日礼物——Jody 爱乱翻、寄到母亲或 Ev/Brooks 处都会被搜出。
facts.anchor: I need to send you Jody’s birthday present. I can’t send it to Mom, ‘cause even though Jody has his own house, he basically still lives there.

facts.fact: 礼物是首版 Jenner Dunn 唱片——签名装裱限量编号、首印仅八十张。
facts.anchor: It’s a first-press Jenner Dunn record. Signed. Framed. Limited run. Numbered, too. Only eighty of ‘em printed at first.

facts.fact: Reston 靠 Ruth 的建议与合同帮助签了出版合约。
facts.anchor: He signed a publishing deal with a record company recently, thanks to some advice and contract help from Ruth.

facts.fact: 她还剩几个月厨房实习才能签字毕业，暂不确定是否回德州。
facts.anchor: Still a couple months of kitchen internships left before I get signed off and graduate.

facts.fact: 她的恐惧核心：当 Ev 必然发现她和 Brooks，一切就完了。
facts.anchor: Because when Everett inevitably finds out about me and Brooks, it’s all over.

facts.fact: 骑 Mayo 去山脊约四十五分钟，那里有拴马桩和小井。
facts.anchor: Mayo and I ride out to the ridge. It takes us about forty-five minutes, and there’s a fastening post and a small well out there

facts.fact: Jody 短信约明天去他家驯新马、叫她 Pocket Rocket。
facts.anchor: hey pocket rocket my place 2moro to break new horse
